$comment: The ONLY characters allowed in HSK AI video frames. Exact vector source copied from the HSK AI app; never redesign. Render PNG references with scripts/build-character-references.mjs.
rules: Whenever a frame needs a character, use only characters from this file. Never draw a human as a character and never invent another mascot or another version of these characters.
Pass each shown character's reference PNG (content/characters/<id>-idle.png, or the mood that fits) as a reference image and add its identity text to the prompt.
Keep shape, colours, outline weight and face exactly; only pose, size in the scene, gesture, props and weather layers may change when the script needs them.

Choose the character by its role when the script does not name one: panda = main coach and the learner's own voice (я), crane = tall and precise (grammar), dragon = energy and milestones, monkey = drills and dialogue, rabbit = memory and warnings.

characters.name: Panda
characters.identity: Panda (熊猫), the main HSK AI coach: a flat 2D vector mascot with a thick dark outline; round white head with soft beige shading on its right side, round black ears, large black oval eye patches with black eyes and tiny white highlights, pink cheeks, small dark nose; short chubby white body with a cream belly patch, black arms and legs.
